name: Artificial Intelligence: Principles and Practice
description: Combining foundational theory with hands‑on programming, this volume introduces machine learning, neural networks, and ethical AI. Code snippets in Python accompany each concept, and capstone projects simulate real‑world deployments. The authors emphasize transparency and responsible AI development.
shortDescription: A practical textbook covering AI fundamentals and ethical considerations.

reviews.title: Comprehensive Guide with Practical Examples
reviews.comment: The book offers a solid foundation in AI concepts while also diving into real-world applications, which I found very helpful. The clear explanations and well-structured chapters make complex topics approachable, and the included code snippets let me try out the techniques right away.
